item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will cover Guangdong in the next few days. The weather will be generally fine and very hot over the region. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the inland areas. With the anticyclone aloft weakening over the weekend, showers will increase over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, an area of low pressure is expected to develop gradually over the seas east of the Philippines midweek this week and then move towards the vicinity of Luzon, with a higher chance of entering the South China Sea. However, there are uncertainties in its movement and intensity. Tropical Cyclone Bualoi will move across the northern part of Vietnam today, moving into the inland areas of Indo-China and dissipating gradually.
